R: Reflectance, as a fraction of the light (100R is the percent)

L: Distance from the touching edge to the spacer
n: Index of refraction of the material below
n_1: Index of the medium above the film
n_2: Index of the medium below the film
n_f: Index of refraction of the film
t: Thickness of the film (or of the wedge's gap)
theta_t: Angle of the light inside the film
x: Distance from the edge where the slides touch (Δx: fringe spacing)
